title: Little Pony and Harmony Chest
statementMd:
Princess Twilight went to Celestia and Luna's old castle to research the chest from the Elements of Harmony.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a3ef8a52159543f9f492c793d1e8f2d1ade243b7.png)

A sequence of positive integers $*b*_{*i*}$ is harmony if and only if for every two elements of the sequence their greatest common divisor equals 1. According to an ancient book, the key of the chest is a harmony sequence $*b*_{*i*}$ which minimizes the following expression:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5331e97de229b75f7e048dc3743c158557e6dbcc.png)

You are given sequence $*a*_{*i*}$, help Princess Twilight to find the key.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the number of elements of the sequences $*a*$ and $*b*$. The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 30$).

## Output

Output the key — sequence $*b*_{*i*}$ that minimizes the sum described above. If there are multiple optimal sequences, you can output any of them.
statementZhMd:
暮光闪闪公主前往塞拉斯蒂娅和露娜的古老城堡，研究和谐之元的宝箱。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a3ef8a52159543f9f492c793d1e8f2d1ade243b7.png)

当且仅当一个正整数序列 $*b*_{*i*}$ 中任意两个元素的最大公约数都等于 $1$ 时，该序列才是和谐的。根据一本古老的书籍，宝箱的钥匙是一个使下列表达式最小的和谐序列 $*b*_{*i*}$：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5331e97de229b75f7e048dc3743c158557e6dbcc.png)

给定序列 $*a*_{*i*}$，请帮助暮光闪闪公主找到这把钥匙。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$），表示序列 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 的元素个数。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 30$）。

## 输出格式

输出使上述表达式中的和最小的钥匙，即序列 $*b*_{*i*}$。如果存在多个最优序列，输出其中任意一个即可。
